✅ The C/T ratio matrix shows the actual c_i * t_j^-1 mod N values
The Pattern
The ratios form a Latin square with three distinct values cyclically permuted:
Row 1: [A, B, C]
Row 2: [B, C, A]
Row 3: [C, A, B]
Where:
• 
A = 74424244563752138601289037432085522087929884770829694480199071199255661033998
• 
B = 94490662625269130568689320735161001677554580068607736135265552201627463318622
• 
C = 62669271285611121677163611850129291940190663718712378149745702882153198636054
What This Means
The c and t families are rotationally symmetric - each c_i is a constant multiple of the t_j family, creating the cyclic Latin square pattern. This is the correct result using the actual cube roots, not the buggy unity-root version.
